posts.title: The Moderate Is Whoever Quotes the Second Number
posts.description: Medicare for All polls at 66% or 43% depending on whether the question names what it costs. The midterms turned on the second number, and the left has been quoting the first.

posts.title: Equal Person: a districting rule you can read
posts.description: Congressional districts drawn from 2020 census block groups by a rule small enough to audit, plus the arithmetic ceiling nobody mentions and a census check on whether the rule favors anyone.

posts.title: Layoffs Don't Pay for the Data Centers
posts.description: Meta spent $1.18 billion on severance and about $140 billion on data centers in 2026. The layoffs did not pay for the data centers. Cash flow and debt did, and the cost shows up later as depreciation.
